export_evidence: ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/jsw-cement-limited) shows 307 customs records for JSW CEMENT LIMITED, JINDAL MANSION, 5A, DR. G.D. DESHMUKH MARG, but the visible rows are IMPORT entries, e.g. "2026-02-23 | JSW CEMENT FZC | JSW CEMENT LIMITED | CLINKER (IN BULK) (COMMERCIAL INVOICE NO.JSW/CLINKER/2025-26/105 DT.17.02.2026) | Mina Saqr, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES -> DHARMATAR PORT MUMBAI INDMT1, India | HS 25231000 | BOL 7691268" and "2026-02-27 | ASHON INTERNATIONAL DMCC | JSW CEMENT LIMITED | STEAM COAL IN BULK | Vanino, RUSSIA -> KRISHNAPATNAM PORT | HS 27011920 | BOL 7785240". No outbound (India -> foreign destination) bill of lading with date, destination and HS code was visible on any free page. Source counter: ImportKey reports "Total Shipments 307 Records detected"; rows actually seen in the free view = 5 (all import-side). Export-side free views on volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused), so no independent export B/L could be retrieved.
domestic_evidence: Domestic supply is evidenced by the company's own investor disclosures and by the import records of raw material/clinker flows into its Indian plants: JSW Cement's investor section (https://www.jswcement.in/investors) publishes "Financial Results", "Annual Reports", "Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report", "Credit Rating" and "Stock Exchange Releases" — i.e. it is a listed-disclosure-grade operating cement producer with audited revenue, not a shell. Plant-level activity is corroborated by customs lines naming its sites, e.g. "2026-02-06 | LOESCHE GMBH | JSW CEMENT LIMITED | COUPLING G 12L (PARTS FOR JOBSITE NAGAUR JSW CL VNR009) ... | DUESSELDORF, GERMANY -> DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | HS 73072900 | BOL 7367036" and clinker imports discharged at "DHARMATAR PORT MUMBAI" and "JAIGARH PORT MAHARASHTRA INJGD1" for domestic grinding. Exact GST turnover band and GeM/CPPP contract values were NOT retrieved (no free page read in this session) — recorded as null, not estimated.
note: Legal entity JSW CEMENT LIMITED (JSW Group, Mumbai) exists and is active — no liquidation/bankruptcy ground for rejection. Declared HS 681099 (articles of cement/concrete) does not match the actual trade profile seen in customs data, which is bulk clinker (HS 25231000), steam coal (27011920) and plant machinery parts (73072900); per project rule the HS is corrected to the factual codes and the company is retained, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Shipment factuality: the 307-record customs footprint is real and dated (latest 2026-02-27), but every row actually visible is an IMPORT into India — the free sources did not expose a single outbound export B/L with date/destination/HS, so export_status is declared_only, not confirmed. Domestic supply is confirmed at the level of audited listed-company disclosures plus named plant sites (Nagaur, Bilakalagudur/Varanasi variants appear in the name list); GST band and tender values are null because they were not publicly readable here. No sanctions/court issues were checked or used as a criterion.
